messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-gateway (prod-usw2) 5xx-rate > 7.5% for 3m. Signal: http.traffic.errors.5xx. Details: 502/503 spike from upstream proxy. <http://runbook.internal/r/inference-5xx|runbook>
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident created: INC-2023-4591 (auto-page). Escalation policy: infra-oncall -> infra-senior.
Jess: acked. I'm on it. Assigning to myself for initial triage :wave:
Sam: saw the alert. Any customer-facing errors? metrics/dashboard shows 22% 502s for inference requests last 5m.
Jess: confirmed. Top affected routes: /v1/generate (inference-gateway). Spike started ~18:12 UTC. Several large orgs seeing retries.
Maya: linking runbook steps: check ingress keepalives, kvcache eviction, proxy 502s. Suggest quick mitigation: offload 20% traffic to fallback pool and scale proxy pool.
Jess: running quick health checks: `curl -I https://inference-gw.prod-usw2.internal/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` for control nodes, but `502` on node(s) behind load-balancer.
Alex: logs show repeated `upstream read: connection reset by peer` from proxy->model-worker. Possible keepalive churn after recent kernel patch.
Sam: starting traffic slice now: `traffic-slicer reroute --service inference-gateway --percent 20 --to fallback-pool` (dry-run -> apply).
Jess: `traffic-slicer` applied. 20% traffic rerouted to fallback-pool. Monitoring error rate.
incidentbot: automation: scaled deployment inference-proxy-prod-usw2 from 6 -> 10 replicas (requested by Alex). See: infra deploy log.
Alex: also restarting the proxy sidecar on the two failing pods: `kubectl rollout restart ds/proxy-sidecar -n prod-usw2 --field-selector=metadata.name in (proxy-42,proxy-43)` -> restarted, liveness passing.
Maya: FYI runbook recommended: if keepalive/KV eviction, increase `proxy.keepalive.max` to 1024 and bump `proxy.conn_reuse` to true. Planning config change if error persists.
Jess: error rate dropped to ~6% after reroute+scale. Still above threshold. Open to doing keepalive tweak next if it doesn't fall under 5% in 10m.
Priya: I'm up next on morning handoff in 40m — want a short blameless note for handoff? I'll take post-mitigation verification and coordinate customer comms if needed.
Jess: yes — leaving notes in the incident channel and will create follow-up ticket for config change + postmortem. Current customer impact: intermittent 5xx on /v1/generate affecting retries for some tenants, no data loss.
Sam: adding quick mitigations summary to INC-2023-4591: reroute 20% -> fallback, scaled proxies 6->10, restarted two sidecars, monitoring. Will watch for regression.
incidentbot: Alert: http.traffic.errors.5xx rate dropped to 3.9% (5m). Auto-close conditions not met yet. Continue monitoring.
Jess: moving to monitoring mode. If stable for 30m we'll close. Priya will take the handoff in 40m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya: acknowledged — will follow up at handoff. Please @me on the final summary. I'll draft customer comms if we need to proactively notify high-traffic tenants.
Alex: filing config-change RFC for keepalive tweak (link will be in the follow-up ticket).
Jess: closing triage thread here but keeping incident open until 30m stable. Logged timeline & immediate actions in INC-2023-4591. :lock:
